summary: Mobile Phase-2 parity (Their Care / Providers & Paperwork / Your Account) verified via code review + Expo web-preview UI on 8 target screens. Logged in as cathy@example.com and navigated to care-plans, plan-billing, scenarios, hospital, amendments, participants. All required testIDs render, screens do not crash, and API calls hit the correct endpoints. No functional bugs found. One minor UX/parity note about the mobile DateField behaviour on the web preview only (native picker is used on iOS/Android per Platform check — web renders a DD/MM/YYYY TextInput as designed).

critical_code_review_comments: DateField on Platform.OS==='web' renders a DD/MM/YYYY masked TextInput (not <input type=date>). Intentional for AU date parity, but reviewers testing via Expo web preview will not see a real calendar popover — the native picker only fires on iOS/Android. Consider swapping to <input type=date> under web if you want the calendar UX in preview as well.

care-plans.tsx cp-compare-toggle is only rendered when Active plans.length >= 2 — cathy@example.com currently has 0 active + 26 archived, so compare cannot be exercised via UI without restoring/uploading plans. Web has the same guard so this is parity-correct, but seed data would help future regression runs.
